subject.title: Voice transcript recovery turn generates response but delivery-mirror drops Telegram reply

question: Should this issue be promoted now to a maintainer-run live Telegram voice-transcript recovery investigation, or should it keep waiting for reporter logs/proof before choosing a repair boundary?
rationale: Source inspection shows a plausible queued-final/fallback accounting gap, but not enough exact proof to choose between recovery correlation, final delivery, transcript mirroring, or fallback suppression as the safe fix boundary.

options.title: Run live recovery proof
options.body: Use a real Telegram voice or forwarded-voice flow to capture the recovery turn, generated final, delivery mirror, and outbound message state before authorizing a fix.

options.title: Wait for reporter evidence
options.body: Keep the issue open with needs-info until redacted logs or a fresh reproduction identifies the failing boundary.

options.title: Track only adjacent fallback work
options.body: Defer this issue behind the related Telegram fallback PR, accepting that voice recovery delivery may remain unproven afterward.

recommendation.title: Run live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Use a real Telegram voice or forwarded-voice flow to capture the recovery turn, generated final, delivery mirror, and outbound message state before authorizing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from recent reply-delivery merger history and current fallback/recovery-adjacent blame.
